question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Social**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank is asking for an adjective that describes the context of the question.
 
• **Social **refers to the interactions and relationships between individuals or groups within a society. (किसी समाज के भीतर व्यक्तियों या समूहों के बीच बातचीत और संबंध)
 
• In this case, the question is likely asking for an adjective that describes a particular issue or problem that relates to society as a whole.
 
• Examples of social issues could include poverty, inequality, discrimination, or crime.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Economic **refers to issues related to money, resources, and financial systems. (धन, संसाधनों और वित्तीय प्रणालियों से संबंधित मुद्दे)
 
• **Psychological **refers to issues related to mental health, emotions, and behaviour. (मानसिक स्वास्थ्य, भावनाओं और व्यवहार से संबंधित मुद्दे)
 
• **Political **refers to issues related to government, laws, and policies. (सरकार, कानून और नीतियों से संबंधित मुद्दे)
